text:
pagerbot: PAGER: GPU pool utilization >= 98% for 7m. Queue growth detected (>600 pending jobs). Service impact: generation latency degrading. Severity: P1. Pager routed to SRE - oncall.
SRE - oncall: acked. jumping in. seeing autoscaler trying to add nodes but failing.
Maria (eng-infra): I see repeated AttachRole failures in controller-manager logs: `AttachRolePolicy: access denied` for nodegroup/gpu-pool-5.
Kev (runtime): kube-autoscaler logs show launchtemplate mismatch error: new nodes coming up with lt-version v8 but ASG expects v6, kubelet taints applied differ.
SRE - oncall: queue length: 612 -> 890 in 18m. Tokenized request latency 95p moved from 120ms -> 1.2s. Customers with reserved capacity still impacted for tail latency.
Anita (customer-ops): flagging top 3 customers on call list. Will open bridge for execs if mitigation not in 20m.
Jonas (prod): is fallback to CPU pool an option for lower-priority workloads? Can we drain to free GPU slots for live traffic?
Maria (eng-infra): quick diagnosis steps: `kubectl get nodes -l nodegroup=gpu-pool-5 -o wide` shows 3 nodes stuck in NotReady with taint `gpu.provisioning=true:NoSchedule`. ASG shows 0 pending instances.
Kev (runtime): autoscaler attempted 4 scale ups. AWS events show `Failed to attach IAM instance profile` intermittently. looks like attachrole race during instance initialization.
SRE - oncall: trying manual scale-up via alternate launch template we tested last week.
SRE - oncall: command: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-5-asg --desired-capacity 6 --honor-cooldown`
OpsBot: Action logged: manual_desired_capacity(6) by SRE - oncall.
Maria (eng-infra): rolling attempt succeeded once earlier but node came up with taint key `gpu.node-provision` preventing pods from scheduling. Need to ensure kubelet bootstrap applies correct tolerations.
Kev (runtime): workaround: patch autoscaler deployment to allow attaching nodes with `--ignore-taints` flag and create a temporary toleration on critical daemonset. Not ideal but buys time.
SRE - oncall: applying toleration patch to critical serving deployment.
SRE - oncall: kubectl patch ds redwood-runtime -n inference -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu.node-provision","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'
Maria (eng-infra): confirming: new node joined: ip 10.10.23.45, kubelet version 1.25.3, taints present but toleration allowed scheduling. Pod placement resumed.
Kev (runtime): queue draining rate improved. pending jobs down to 310. latency 95p back to ~420ms and trending down.
Anita (customer-ops): notifying customers A/B: "We are mitigating GPU capacity exhaustion; degraded latency observed; mitigation in progress."
Jonas (prod): any root cause hypothesis?
Maria (eng-infra): preliminary: IAM/attachrole race during instance boot + launch template drift between ASG and kube-autoscaler causing intermittent nodes to be provisioned with wrong bootstrap config (taints + missing instance profile).
Kev (runtime): we'll add an autoscaler guard to verify launch template id before marking scale-up complete. Also add retry on attachrole errors.
SRE - oncall: creating immediate runbook entry in incident doc and tagging eng-infra + runtime for follow-up.
Maria (eng-infra): follow-ups: 1) reconcile LT versions in ASG, 2) rotate instance profile to stable ARN, 3) add preflight check in bootstrap to reapply toleration rules if missing.
Anita (customer-ops): customers informed. No active escalations requested.
SRE - oncall: handing off to Maria for next 2h postmortem and long-term fixes. I'll remain reachable for 30m.
Maria (eng-infra): taking lead. next steps: capture logs (controller-manager, autoscaler, cloudtrail attach role events) and produce impact summary (requests delayed, top customers affected, duration).
OpsBot: Incident state changed: mitigated -> under investigation.
Kev (runtime): adding playbook entry: `if attachrole fails X times within Y, fallback to spare-asg with stable LT`.
SRE - oncall: checkin in 10m. good work team :thumbsup:
Maria (eng-infra): last check: pending queue 198. will compile timeline.
Anita (customer-ops): prepping customer post with ETA for full resolution and link to status page.
Jonas (prod): filing JIRA for on-call runbook improvements + retro.
SRE - oncall: closing pager for now. leaving thread open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
